wylie: rtags gsum pa ma grub na, spyi chos can, khyod ma yin zhing rtag pa yin pa'i gzhi mthun pa du ma grub par thal, rtag dngos gnyis de yang de yin, mtshan mtshon gnyis de yang de yin pa'i phyir
english: Suppose next that you disagree with the third reason above.  Let's consider then qualities. There do too exist many things which are not qualities but which are still unchanging things, Because the pair of changing things and unchanging things would be one such example; and the pair of definitions and the things that definitions define would be another.
